# Flagsmith API Reference

> Flagsmith's Core and SDK APIs. Check out <a href='https://docs.flagsmith.com'>Flagsmith documentation</a>.

## API Reference

- [Flagsmith API](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html): Flagsmith's Core and SDK APIs. Check out <a href='https://docs.flagsmith.com'>Flagsmith documentation</a>.
- [POST /api/v1/analytics/flags/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-analytics-flags-post): POST /api/v1/analytics/flags/ - Class to handle flag analytics events
- [POST /api/v1/auth/logout/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-auth-logout-post): POST /api/v1/auth/logout/ - Use this endpoint to logout user (remove user authentication token).
- [POST /api/v1/cb-webhook/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-cb-webhook-post): POST /api/v1/cb-webhook/ - Endpoint to handle webhooks from chargebee.
- [PUT /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/api-keys/{id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-api-keys-id-put): PUT /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/api-keys/{id}/ - Manage server-side SDK keys for an environment.
- [DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/{cohort_id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-cohorts-cohort-id-delete): DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/{cohort_id}/ - Request cohort deletion. Memberships are drained from identity data first; the cohort and its segment are deleted once drained.
- [DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/sync-keys/{prefix}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-cohorts-sync-keys-prefix-delete): DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/cohorts/sync-keys/{prefix}/ - Revoke a cohort sync key.
- [DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiment-metrics/{id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-experiment-metrics-id-delete): DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiment-metrics/{id}/ - Manage experiment metrics for an environment.
- [DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiments/{experiment_experiment_id}/metrics/{id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-experiments-experiment-experiment-id-metrics-id-delete): DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiments/{experiment_experiment_id}/metrics/{id}/ - Manage metrics for an experiment.
- [DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiments/{experiment_id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-experiments-experiment-id-delete): DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiments/{experiment_id}/ - Manage experiments for an environment.
- [DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/featurestates/{id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-featurestates-id-delete): DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/featurestates/{id}/ - View set to manage feature states. Nested beneath environments and environments + identities
- [DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/identities/{identity_pk}/featurestates/{id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-identities-identity-pk-featurestates-id-delete): DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/identities/{identity_pk}/featurestates/{id}/ - View set to manage feature states. Nested beneath environments and environments + identities
- [DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/warehouse-connections/{connection_id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-warehouse-connections-connection-id-delete): DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/warehouse-connections/{connection_id}/ - Manage data warehouse connections for an environment.
- [DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/webhooks/{id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-webhooks-id-delete): DELETE /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/webhooks/{id}/ - Manage webhooks for an environment.
- [GET /api/v1/features/download-feature-export/{feature_export_id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-features-download-feature-export-feature-export-id-get): GET /api/v1/features/download-feature-export/{feature_export_id}/ - This endpoint is to download a feature export file from a specific environment
- [GET /api/v1/features/download-flagsmith-on-flagsmith/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-features-download-flagsmith-on-flagsmith-get): GET /api/v1/features/download-flagsmith-on-flagsmith/ - This endpoint is to download a feature export to enable Flagsmith on Flagsmith
- [DELETE /api/v1/features/feature-segments/{id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-features-feature-segments-id-delete): DELETE /api/v1/features/feature-segments/{id}/ - Deletes a segment override. Applies to environments without v2 feature versioning (use_v2_feature_versioning: false).
- [GET /api/v1/flags/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-flags-get): GET /api/v1/flags/ - Retrieve the feature flags for an environment.
- [GET /api/v1/flags/{identifier}](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-flags-identifier-get): GET /api/v1/flags/{identifier} - Retrieve the feature flags for an environment.
- [POST /api/v1/oauth/authorize/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-oauth-authorize-post): POST /api/v1/oauth/authorize/ - Process a consent decision and return the redirect URI.
- [DELETE /api/v1/projects/{project_pk}/features/{feature_pk}/mv-options/{id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-projects-project-pk-features-feature-pk-mv-options-id-delete): DELETE /api/v1/projects/{project_pk}/features/{feature_pk}/mv-options/{id}/ - Deletes a multivariate option.
- [POST /api/v1/analytics/telemetry/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-analytics-telemetry-post): POST /api/v1/analytics/telemetry/ - Class to handle telemetry events from self hosted APIs so we can aggregate and track
- [POST /api/v1/auth/login/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-auth-login-post): POST /api/v1/auth/login/ - Class to handle throttling for login requests
- [POST /api/v1/auth/login/code/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-auth-login-code-post): POST /api/v1/auth/login/code/ - Override class to add throttling
- [POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/webhook/cohorts/{id}/members/add/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-cohort-sync-webhook-cohorts-id-members-add-post): POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/webhook/cohorts/{id}/members/add/ - Add members to a CSV cohort. Accepted deltas are applied to identity data asynchronously. Re-adding a member is a no-op, so retries are safe.
- [POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/webhook/cohorts/{id}/members/remove/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-cohort-sync-webhook-cohorts-id-members-remove-post): POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/webhook/cohorts/{id}/members/remove/ - Remove members from a CSV cohort. Accepted deltas are applied to identity data asynchronously. Removing a non-member is a no-op, so retries are safe.
- [GET /api/v1/environment-feature-versions/{id}/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environment-feature-versions-id-get): GET /api/v1/environment-feature-versions/{id}/ - This is an additional endpoint to retrieve a specific version without needing
- [POST /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/api-keys/](/flagsmith-api-docs/api-reference.html#operation-api-v1-environments-environment-api-key-api-keys-post): POST /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/api-keys/ - Manage server-side SDK keys for an environment.
